chunks: And with this chain of narration, it was said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The head (essence) of intellect, after faith in Allah, is being affectionate towards people and doing good to every righteous and wicked person.
ai.seo_question: What is considered the highest form of intellect after faith in Islam?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Shaykh al-Saduq records the Prophet’s definition of the pinnacle of intellect as social cohesion through universal benevolence, extending kindness to both the righteous and the wicked. This aligns with the Shia emphasis on *Aql* not merely as cognitive reasoning but as practical wisdom manifested in ethical conduct and social harmony, reflecting the comprehensive nature of Prophetic character.
